svg.aria-label: PSOLA Grain Synthesis and Formant Shifting
svg.text: Absolute Mode: PSOLA Grain Overlap-Add & Formant Shifting
Grain spacing sets pitch (T_target); keeping grains intact preserves formants, while resampling inside each grain shifts them
1. Input audio & analysis pitch marks (T₀ = 5.0 ms)
Marks spaced by T₀; Hann grains span ±T₀
2. Pitch up +7 st, formants preserved (T_target = 3.33 ms, formant = 1.0)
Closer spacing raises pitch; grain waveform unchanged
3. Same pitch, formant up (T_target = 3.33 ms, formant = 1.35)
Grains resampled 1.35× faster; radius = T₀ / formant
